about: Record kind for dungeons injected into the leveling route. Each run: pick-ups as `when dungeon` steps after (or before) an anchored route goal; `runStop`: the pick-ups repeated at the run's own stop (the cheap, local catch-up for a player who opts in after the earlier pick-ups); the run step after `run.after`, guarded by `when dungeon` + `when onquest <run.objectives>`; each hand-in as a `when dungeon` + `when complete`/`when onquest` step after its anchor (every step of a run is behind `when dungeon`, so a character who skips it keeps the solo route's steps and numbers); `soloWay`: a solo step of a stop the run shares, behind `when !dungeon`; `run.insideEnds`: a pick-up's quest handed in inside the dungeon, to an NPC with no place in the data: the run step turns it in at the door's place (`turnin <quest> npc <npc> @<entrance>`), so it leaves the log with the run; `run.insideQuests`: quests given and taken inside, named in the run tip; `run.itemStarts`: quests an item found inside starts, handed in after the run behind `when onquest`; `budget`: the measured cost vs the solo route (flow audit dynamic + level model). A Forge writer rule or a check reproduces the hand edits from these. Gates (Fitz, 2026-11-13: never a dungeon too low): `run.gate` is the `when level>=` the run step carries, the dungeon's floor in the Codex (data/forever/codex/journal.json: the client's Group Finder minimum, its fixed minimum or players' recorded entry level, whichever is highest; forge guide lint errors on a run gated under it); a pick-up's `gate` is that floor less the levels the calibrated level model plans between the pick-up and the run (forge judge doors --levels checks it), so a player on pace is asked and one far behind is not; a `runStop` pick-up carries the run's gate. The travel steps of a branch that leaves the solo route's way (the runner's trip out to the door and back) carry the run's gate too, and a runner's step that shares a goal with a `soloWay` step keeps that goal in an ungated step of its own, so a runner under the gate still has it. `checks`: the facts a run's steps rest on that wait for an in-game check (`status` `needs-ingame`; `at` the step, `pickup`, `run` or `handin`; `quest` where it is one quest's; `what` to look at).

notInRoute.why: Left out of the route on purpose: for the Alliance its quests' city stops cost a ~1,450 yd walk from Ironforge's gate and back, and the Horde's Rig Wars is a hand-in waiting a whole guide; its Dungeons page has the pick-up and hand-in guides.

No quest of the dungeon itself can be taken in its window on the route: the necklace chain starts with Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar, whose route visit (43-45) comes after the only Badlands visit (39-40); the quests the Badlands visit meets (Solution to Doom, Power Stones, the reagent runs) are done outside the dungeon, and Jarkal Mossmeld offers Uldaman Reagent Run only at the end of the visit. A run would have no quest to guard it.

The route reaches the mountain's foot on 50-60/01's Blackrock Stronghold step at ~52.1, about 440 yd from the mountain's Burning Steppes gate, but none of the dungeon's quests is in reach there: The Heart of the Mountain (55) is 3 levels over, The Good Stuff and Incendius! are 56, and Dark Iron Legacy starts with Franclorn Forgewright's spirit, spoken to as a ghost.

No giver on a stop the route makes in its window (Mebok in Ratchet, Falfindel in Feralas, Veyric Thunderhame in the Arathi Highlands are off the route then); the nearest point the route passes in the window is 1,041 yd from the door (30-40/03-ashenvale's way into the Barrens).

The route never enters the Wetlands in the dungeon's window; its one giver on the route, Zaruk in Hammerfall (Dragonmaw Rumors, 30-33), sends you 2,956 yd across the Thandol Span to the dig and its other givers are off the route.
The route never enters Tirisfal Glades.

The route's only Tirisfal point in the window is the zeppelin tower at 32-34, 1,244 yd from the door; Varimathras' quest is level 42 there (8 over) and the other givers are off the route (Thunder Bluff, the Undercity's Parqual Fintallas chain).
No route visit in its window (35-41): the nearest point is 1,048 yd away at 32-33, and its givers are off the route or inside.
No route visit in its window (35-41): the nearest point in it is about 4 km away; its givers are off the route or inside, Varimathras' An Unholy Alliance starts from an item inside.

The route's Desolace visit (38-39) passes 347 yd from the door but below the quests' minimum levels (39 to 45): Willow's Twisted Evils needs 41, Archmage Tervosh's Shadowshard Fragments is offered at 40-43 in Theramore, the others are off the route.
The route is in Desolace only at 32-34, below the dungeon (42-51) and its quests (minimum 39 to 45).
The route passes the temple at 45-47, below its quests (level 50-53, minimum 46-50), and does not come back to the Swamp of Sorrows later.

Loremaster Dibbs' Take Two With Water needs An Acquaintance in Southshore (95786, from Brother Nimetz once Troll Witchery is handed in at ~42 in 40-50/01); the route's next Southshore visit (40-50/02, ~43) comes after its last Stranglethorn visit, and Krazek's two quests give no experience.

Kin'weelay offers The Drowned City in Grom'gol only once Locating the Lost City is handed in, after the route has already been at the entrance; a run would be a 681 yd trip back to the Vile Reef and a second Grom'gol visit for the hand-in.
